title: Social‑Media Video Creative (2D/3D & AI‑Video Focus)
description: About MEXC Founded in 2018, MEXC is a global cryptocurrency exchange serving millions of users worldwide. We are committed to building a secure, efficient, and accessible platform for digital asset trading. MEXC is known for offering some of the lowest trading fees in the market, deep liquidity across a wide range of assets, and fast access to trending tokens. Our platform provides a comprehensive suite of services including spot trading, derivatives, staking, and other digital asset products designed for both retail and institutional users. Built on high-performance infrastructure and a user-first philosophy, MEXC delivers fast execution, strong market depth, and a seamless trading experience for global users. At MEXC, we believe the best platforms are built through constant improvement and open collaboration. We value direct communication, practical thinking, and individuals who take ownership of their ideas. Teams are encouraged to share insights, challenge assumptions, and contribute to how the platform evolves. As the digital asset industry continues to evolve, we remain focused on innovation, transparency, and global expansion while building a trusted platform for the next generation of financial technology. Key Responsibilities Responsible for the end‑to‑end independent full‑process production of brand social media video content, including creative conception, script/storyboard design, production execution, and final output, all aligned with social media communication logic and platform characteristics. Coordinate video expression with a "director's mindset", plan picture structure, rhythm, emotion, and narrative methods based on content goals, and create memorable, engaging social media content. Independently complete the entire video production workflow: Creativity → Storyboard → Production ( 2D/3D / Real‑shot / AI‑generated video ) → Output, optimizing content to fit the unique needs of different social media platforms. Collaborate closely with design, marketing, and other cross‑functional teams to deeply understand business requirements and translate them into high‑quality visual content that meets brand standards. Explore and hands‑on leverage AI video generation tools in real production pipelines to continuously improve creation efficiency, enhance content expressiveness, and stay ahead of industry trends. Requirements Bachelor's degree or above, major in Design, Animation, Film and Television, Digital Media, or related fields is preferred. Can independently deliver complete video works end‑to‑end, not only pure post‑production editing. Strong video narrative ability and visual expression skills, with a clear director/creator mindset and a keen eye for detail. Proficient in video production tools: Editing (Premiere Pro / Final Cut Pro / DaVinci Resolve); Motion Graphics/Animation (After Effects / C4D). Hands‑on practical production experience for BOTH 2D motion graphics AND 3D animation.Proven hands‑on production experience using AI‑video generation tools in real commercial projects (text‑to‑video, image‑to‑video, AI‑assisted storyboarding, AI‑generated assets; tools such as Kling, Runway, Pika etc). Good understanding of picture rhythm, shot language, music, and emotional expression; excellent communication skills and execution ability, able to deliver high‑quality work efficiently in a fast‑paced environment. Possess content planning or script‑writing ability, beyond only executive‑level editing work. Portfolio link MANDATORY in your application; applications without portfolio will NOT be reviewed. Why Join Us At MEXC, we believe people do their best work when they are trusted with real responsibility and given the freedom to grow. • Ownership & Initiative – We encourage individuals to take initiative, lead projects, and contribute ideas that help shape how we build and improve the platform. • Learning Culture – We regularly organize internal training programs, knowledge-sharing sessions, and learning initiatives where team members can both develop new skills and share their expertise with others. • Ideas That Matter – New ideas are welcomed and discussed openly. Team members have a real voice in shaping which proposals move forward, and meaningful contributions are recognized and rewarded. • Room to Grow – As a rapidly expanding global exchange, roles evolve quickly and individuals often have opportunities to expand their scope and take on greater responsibilities. • Global Collaboration – Work with colleagues across different regions and cultures while contributing to a platform used by millions of users worldwide.
